title: Runbook: Submissions Stuck in Processing State
trigger_condition: Multiple PolicyPeriod records stuck in 'Processing' with no user-visible error, typically following a deployment or upgrade.
steps: Check app server logs for GosuRuntimeException around PolicyPeriod.bind() or related bind-time rules.
Cross-reference the exception against the latest Guidewire release notes for any renamed or removed API methods in custom rule sets.
If a custom Gosu rule references a deprecated/removed API, patch the rule and redeploy to one app server first to validate before full rollout.
Run the StuckSubmissionReprocess batch script to clear and resubmit affected PolicyPeriods once the fix is deployed.
Notify underwriting leads once cleared and confirm no new occurrences for 2 hours.

title: Runbook: Monthly Invoice Batch Reconciliation Check
trigger_condition: After every monthly invoice generation batch run, regardless of reported batch status.
steps: Do not rely solely on batch job 'success' status - a 0-error run can still silently skip accounts.
Run the post-batch reconciliation report comparing invoice count to count of active billable accounts.
If variance exceeds 1%, investigate filter conditions in InvoiceGenBatch.gs for any deprecated fields.
Escalate to BillingCenter L3 if the data model has changed in a recent upgrade and batch filters were not migrated.

title: Runbook: Diagnosing Peak-Hour UI Latency
trigger_condition: User reports of slow page loads concentrated in a specific time window (e.g. lunch-hour peak concurrency).
steps: Pull APM distributed traces for the affected screen during the reported time window.
Look for N+1 query patterns, especially in recently added or modified UI widgets.
If found, confirm whether a batch-fetch API exists as a replacement (check latest ClaimCenter release notes).
Rewrite the widget's data access layer to use the batch API and load-test at 2x historical peak concurrency before deploying.

title: Runbook: Full Application Outage / Unresponsive App Servers
trigger_condition: All or most app server threads unresponsive; users report complete inability to load the application.
steps: Open MIM bridge immediately and declare incident commander.
Collect thread dumps from at least 2 affected app server nodes before any restart.
Analyze thread dumps for lock contention or deadlock patterns, especially around recently deployed interceptors or filters.
If a recently released feature is implicated, check for a feature flag to disable it as immediate mitigation rather than a full rollback.
Engage vendor support with thread dump evidence if the root cause is in vendor-shipped code.
File a formal RCA within 48 hours including root cause, immediate mitigation, and long-term corrective actions.

title: Runbook: Outbound File Rejected by External Partner
trigger_condition: A scheduled outbound file transfer (payments, data extracts) is rejected by an external partner's validation.
steps: Check the partner's most recent format/spec advisory emails or portal notices.
Confirm our team is on the correct advisory distribution list for this partner; if not, request to be added immediately.
Update the IntegrationGateway mapping template to match the new spec.
Validate against the partner's sandbox/test endpoint before resubmitting to production.
Document the spec change and add it to the integration partner's change log for future reference.

title: Runbook: License Pool Exhausted / Users Cannot Log In
trigger_condition: Users receive 'no license available' errors despite headcount being within the licensed pool.
steps: Check for orphaned/stale sessions, especially following any recent VPN or network outage.
Run the session-cleanup script to release stale concurrent-user licenses.
Verify license pool is restored to expected availability.
If exhaustion recurs without a clear incident cause, request a license headroom review with the Guidewire account team.
